2026-05.notes:
[Highlight] The FRED PA-1 Bundle leads campaign is the standout performer this month at $6.12 CPL — well below the EasyPort campaign ($8.72). Consider increasing the FRED daily budget from $25 to $35–$40 to capitalise on this efficiency before the EOFY period ends.

[Watch] EasyPort campaign frequency has reached 2.77 — above the 2.5 warning threshold. Audience fatigue is likely building. Refresh creative or expand targeting in June to prevent CPL from climbing.

[Instagram] Content interactions jumped 350% month-on-month — a significant spike. Identify which posts drove this and double down on that content format. Link clicks are also up 33%, suggesting improving intent.

[Facebook] Link clicks on Facebook are up 11.2% despite a drop in unique viewers (−13.7%). This points to a more engaged, returning audience rather than new reach — a healthy signal for the brand.

[Audience] Melbourne (23.2%) dominates the audience with Sydney second at 8.9%. Victoria and NSW combined account for ~32% of reach. Geo-targeted content or city-specific ad sets could improve relevance and conversion rates.

[EOFY] The EOFY 2026 campaign is tracking spend ($264 at $40/day) but purchase conversions are not yet confirmed. Review conversion data before end of June and reallocate budget to FRED leads campaign if ROAS is not meeting targets.
